text: K(11) >= 593: the 593 integer direction vectors AlphaEvolve published (May 2025) are a kissing configuration in R^11 — no two closer than 60 degrees, i.e. 4·p·|p| <= |u|^2 |v|^2 for every pair, p = <u, v>

source.what: google-deepmind/alphaevolve_results, mathematical_results.ipynb (section B.11), pinned in corpus/sources

domain.decoder: the JSON field "vectors": 593 rows of 11 integers, the notebook's cell B.11 extracted here 2026-09-03 (the extraction is this repository's; the integers are the notebook's)

reference: no bar is printed: the zero of the structural inequality; the claim is the count, 593 directions pairwise at least 60 degrees apart, decided from the integers alone
hypotheses: two directions u, v are at least 60 degrees apart iff <u, v> <= |u||v|/2, i.e. p <= 0 or 4p^2 <= |u|^2|v|^2, which is the one inequality 4·p·|p| <= |u|^2 |v|^2 (p = <u, v>)
a set of n directions pairwise at least 60 degrees apart is a kissing configuration of n (the unit spheres centred at the unit directions touch the central sphere and do not overlap)
falsifier: some pair of the pinned vectors has 4·p·|p| > |u|^2 |v|^2
